technical.summary: Short-term bullish structure (EMA 9/21 cross, new 10-day high) conflicts with overbought conditions, weak intermediate trend, and price below 200-SMA; moderate swing entry with elevated risk of pullback.

debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought momentum extremes, price below 200-SMA and Ichimoku cloud, weak intermediate trend (EMA/SMA 20/50 false), negative CMF/AO, VIX crisis (397.6), and high earnings risk in 37 days create a hostile macro environment that invalidates the short-term bullish setup.

decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (397.6) combined with earnings in 37 days and negative macro environment (flat yield curve, rising USD) creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs short-term technical setup.
